card.name: Animal study dose comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as at and the (also relevant, or a decimal point) just before a dose or exposure multiple in animal toxicity studies, as in 'in rats at doses up to' or '0.2 times the MRHD'.

modes.label: at before doses
modes.description: The word at after an animal species, introducing the dose level tested.
modes.example: No evidence of carcinogenicity was found in two 2-year bioassays in rats<< at>> doses up to 100 mg
